headline: The /dusicky/ hub is live with a map of Czechia (a dot per town page), the towns grouped by diocese, a 'Najdi obec' filter and an opt-in 'Podle mé polohy' sort. Of 150 churches with an ambiguous title, 32 now show their feast from a parish source and 118 still show nothing. iOS: builds 81–88 of 1.4 are on App Store Connect, all from CI. Nothing submitted.

shipped.title: /dusicky/ hub: SVG map of town pages, towns by diocese, Najdi obec, Podle mé polohy
shipped.live_checked: 2026-10-30 ~08:50 UTC, before the Saturday 12:00 CET deadline. Deploy job on 5c7bd0b green. I loaded live https://bohosluzby.dravec.org/dusicky/ in Chromium at 390×844 with an iPhone user agent, with the analytics beacon blocked to keep the KPIs clean. It returned 200 with 1 map, 176 dots, 176 rows and 8 diocese groups in ČBK order. Page width 390, so no sideways scroll. Typing 'jihl' leaves only Jihlava. With the position set to Jihlava, 'Podle mé polohy' sorts Jihlava 0,4 km, Brtnice 10 km, Přibyslav 21 km. The Jihlava dot links to /dusicky/jihlava/, which returns 200. This was emulation, not a physical phone: Pavol should open it once on his own phone.

shipped.title: Title feast from the parish where the church name is ambiguous (32 of 150, each with source and quote)
shipped.live_checked: 2026-10-30 ~09:40 UTC. Deploy on 5c56536 green. Live /kostel/2000316/ (Hejnice) at 390 px: the static page has 'Titulární svátek (pouť): svátek Navštívení Panny Marie, 2. července.', and the app booted on it shows 'titulární svátek (pouť): svátek Navštívení Panny Marie, 2. července'. Live /kostel/200019/ (Jablonné, not settled) shows no line. The /dusicky/ hub still has 176 dots.

notes: Scope: churches the name-reader leaves blank although a feast could apply: 12 plain 'sv. Jakuba' or 'sv. Jakuba apoštola' (Starší 25. 7. or Mladší 3. 5.), 54 with two titles where at least one maps to a feast, and 84 Navštívení P. M. (2. 7. in the Czech calendar, 31. 5. in the universal one). Bare 'Panny Marie' and churches with no feast title at all were not in scope.

Confirmed means the parish website, the parish bulletin or the diocese names the feast or the saint for this church, in text that was read. Each row in data/patron-sources.json carries the URL, the source date, a verbatim quote and the check date.

Confirmed by kind: Navštívení 16 (10 kept on 31. 5., 6 on 2. 7.), sv. Jakub Starší 6, two-title churches 10. In two of those the parish keeps the second title, not the first: Staré Hvězdlice Cyril a Metoděj, Dýšina Šimon a Juda.

Seventeen candidate hits were not counted (twelve at my first pass, five more after the independent review of PR #77: Ostrov, Bohušovice, Heřalec, Sirákov and Kozlovice, which had two poutě or a dedication statement with no feast day), so those churches still show nothing: Šošůvka and Budišov (date inferred from a Sunday, saint not named); Zahnašovice and Hluboké Mašůvky (quote only from a search summary, because the page is behind a bot check); Jablonné v Podještědí, Brno minorité, Rajnochovice and the Jesuit church in Klatovy (the parish keeps two poutě); Ostrava-Zábřeh (pouť on 7 June, near neither date); Běšiny (the parish labels it 31. 5. but keeps it on 5. 7.); Liběšice (pouť tied to the 1743 apparition, not the title); Světlá Hora (Barbora named, but the pouť is in mid-November).

Of the 118 unknown, about 25 parish sites answered 403, a Cloudflare challenge, a TLS error or a reset. Among them: Český Krumlov, Dačice, ČB děkanství, Vimperk, Březnice, Česká Skalice, Roseč, Cheb, Lobendava, Králíky, Frýdek, Milevsko, Ostrovačice, Lišov, Borovany, Náchod, Čížkovice, Sobíňov. These blocks were not circumvented. Many churches have no parish website at all.

Spot check: I re-fetched 10 confirmed quotes. 8 matched the live page verbatim. 2 (svatyjakub.cz Brno, farnost-trnava.cz) refused the re-fetch with HTTP 466, and their rows say so. Some quotes were read from parish poster images (Hejnice, Lomnice, Suchdol); the notes say which.
Registry lead: Ostřetín's parish calls its church 'Zvěstování P. Marie', not Navštívení, so the registry title may be wrong.

decisions.question: Group the hub's towns by kraj or by diocese?
decisions.default_taken: diocese, with the kraje each covers named under each heading
decisions.why: We can derive it from data we already hold: the first digit of the registry id (1 Praha … 8 Brno), checked in a test against the cathedral towns. Kraj would need a boundary dataset. Diocese is also the Schematismus's own order. The note under each heading and the search field cover people who don't know church geography. To switch to kraj: swap DIOCESES for a kraj table plus a boundary lookup at build time.

decisions.question: Map source and form
options: static SVG from Natural Earth border + town centroids
decisions.default_taken: static SVG, built at build time
decisions.why: This is what the brief asked for: no tile server and no third-party script. Natural Earth is public domain, simplified to 446 points (data/geo/cz-border.json). The page is 20 KB gzipped.

decisions.question: Map dots in the keyboard / screen-reader order?
options: aria-hidden, tabindex -1; the list carries every link
decisions.why: 176 tab stops would only repeat the list below. The dots are for tapping.

decisions.question: Which towns get a name on the map?
decisions.default_taken: the see cities (Praha, Plzeň, ČB, HK, Litoměřice, Brno, Olomouc, Ostrava)
decisions.why: They fit the diocese grouping. The 'largest six' put Opava on top of Ostrava.

decisions.question: Position sort: remember it?
decisions.why: The brief asked for 'only after a tap'. The position never leaves the page, and the page says so.

decisions.question: What counts as 'confirmed' for an ambiguous title?
options: any parish mention near the date
the parish names the feast or saint for this church in read text
decisions.why: Pavol's default was 'show nothing', and a wrong date is worse than none. Twelve weaker hits were set back to unknown. Each row has a flag and a note, so a looser rule is a data change.

decisions.question: Use a confirmed title that our feast table hadn't offered as a candidate (Dýšina Šimon a Juda, Otnice sv. Alois, Staré Hvězdlice Cyril a Metoděj)?
decisions.why: It is the church's own title, and the parish source names it.

decisions.question: Show the parish source on the church page?
options: record it in the data only
decisions.why: Pavol kept the patron line as it is, and the brief asked for the source to be recorded in the data.

decisions.question: Dispatch TestFlight after these merges (AGENTS.md: every user-facing merge)?
decisions.why: Item 7 says don't submit anything and list the builds. The hub is a web-only static page. #77's title feasts would reach the app with the next build Pavol cuts.

decisions.question: Ping IndexNow for /dusicky/?
decisions.why: The brief says IndexNow is central.

proposals.name: Map on each /dusicky/<town>/ page (the town's churches as dots)

small static SVG of the town's churches above the ordo
proposals.recommendation: Wait until after 2 Nov and see whether hub visitors use the map. It changes the town pages, which you kept as they are.

proposals.name: Re-checking the 118 unknown titles
options: a second pass from a normal browser for the ~25 bot-walled parish sites
ask parishes (needs your go: it's outreach)
proposals.recommendation: A second pass from a browser in a quieter week. It's cheap, and data/patron-sources.json already lists why each one is open.
